facts.business: Sical Logistics Limited provides integrated logistics services with a primary focus on mining logistics including overburden removal, excavation, coal transportation, and mine development, along with container freight station operations, warehousing, and third-party logistics solutions.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Received Letter of Acceptance from South Eastern Coalfields Limited

auditor.name: SRSV & Associates Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter on contingent liabilities: all pre-CIRP litigations deemed extinguished per resolution plan approved by NCLT on January 11, 2023 (except bank guarantees); no disputed tax dues as at March 31, 2026

key_risks: Competitive intensity in fragmented logistics market
Dependence on mining activity and bulk cargo logistics
Volatility in EXIM trade affecting CFS operations
Rising operating costs (diesel, manpower, equipment maintenance, financing)
Regulatory and environmental risks (mining laws, port regulations, transportation policies, labour legislation)
facts.related_party_note: Ultimate holding company is Pristine Logistics & Infraprojects Limited; operational and financial support from Pristine Group; cross-selling opportunities across mining logistics, rail logistics, warehousing and integrated supply chain solutions
